messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — CloudX just sent a hotpatch advisory: H100 racks in eu-west getting a firmware rollback, ETA +72h for full fleet recovery. They offered a temporary A500 warm pool (48h) as a mitigation. Need fast OK to reserve so our demos/canaries don't fall over. Vendor note: https://cloudx.example.com/notice/123

anita: How many GPUs and what's the rough cost?

vendor-bot: Vendor update — warm pool offer: 16x A500 (eu-west1), duration 48h, price $3.50/hr/GPU. Estimated cost ~ $2.7k. Primary fleet ETA for H100 fix ~72h. See vendor console: https://cloudx.example.com/pools/offer/988 

mike: If we accept, we'll need VPC peering + subnet + IAM roles for demos. Also want a smoke-test plan (quick latency + model sanity). Lina, can you pick up terraform changes + CR?

lina: I can do the TF work and review. Please send subnet & minimal firewall rules. I'll open a PR and run plan. :+1:

sam: Subnet: projects/redwood-net/subnets/eu-demo. Allow 443 and 22 from demo bastion CIDR 10.40.5.0/24. Quick quota check command if anyone needs to verify before reserving:
```
gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --format="json" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```

anita: Finance — can we cover the ~$3k emergency spend? @finance

finance: finance: We can cover up to $3k of unplanned emergency spend from runway for infra incidents. Please tag the cost center and create a spend ticket. We'll retrospectively approve beyond that if justified.

sam: Cost center: ENG-DEVEX-Demos. I'll open a spend ticket and attach vendor quote. Plan is to reserve 16x for 48h unless objections in the next 20m. :eyes:

mike: Also add a fallback policy: if latency > 300ms p95, route to smaller quantized model and scale down batch size. I'll add the rollout policy to the canary config.

oncall: oncall: I'll add a paging rule for demo SLO breaches and a short runbook + escalation. If vendor signals earlier, we'll start soft drain to avoid panic.

lina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/457 — adds cloudx_warm_pool module + demo networking. Terraform plan looks clean on my side, included minimal IAM. PTAL @sam @mike

sam: LGTM from me. I'll create the spend ticket and then approve reservation on the vendor console. Lina, merge after spend ticket created. :thumbsup:

mike: :rocket:

anita: Thanks team — keeping demos green. Will follow up with a brief postmortem once H100 fleet is back.
